Risk settings adjustable before the first live trade.

faqs.q: Can I trade manually?
faqs.a: Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.

faqs.q: What is the minimum deposit?
faqs.a: US$200, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.

faqs.q: How fast are withdrawals?
faqs.a: The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.

faqs.q: Which assets can I trade?
faqs.a: 8 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

bottomLine: The platform itself is workable - the dashboard, the demo and the two trading modes are all present. The caution applies to the claims around them, not the mechanics.
The final score lands at 4.0 - a capable platform held back by its own paperwork. Start small, verify the claims yourself and never trade money you cannot lose.
